subject: Post-call: third-party ecosystem checklist & SQ kickoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus.ai>, James Li <j.li@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: third-party ecosystem checklist & SQ kickoff

Hi Elena / James —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared checklist: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance posture
   - Ask: Can you confirm whether Nimbus has a SOC 2 Type II report for production? If available, please share the report or a download link and an expected cadence for future attestations.

2) Data protection & regulatory applicability
   - You mentioned GDPR applies; can you confirm if any of this workload falls under HIPAA or PHI? If so we'll need to scope a BAA and technical controls.

3) Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ)
   - We're starting the standard Redwood vendor security questionnaire for new integrations. If you can complete a short form we will triage any gaps. I'll attach the questionnaire in the thread if you prefer a PDF.

4) Subprocessor / cloud list & boundaries
   - Please share any third parties that will receive customer data (cloud providers, analytics, telemetry vendors). We'll also share our subprocessors and a short note on data flows.

Next steps I propose: 
- You (Nimbus) return the completed questionnaire and SOC 2 link by EOD next Tue (2027-04-06).
- Marissa will follow up with our subprocessor inventory and a mapping doc.
- Karthik and I will coordinate procurement and DPA/BAA if required.

If that timeline works I will mark it in the deal plan (DEAL-1247). Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here.

Cheers,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
(Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-SQ-v1.pdf (pdf))
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus.ai>

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: third-party ecosystem checklist & SQ kickoff

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the concise recap. Timeline looks good. Answers inline: 

1) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for our core analytics platform (issued 2026-11). I'll attach the notarized PDF. We rotate audits annually.
(Attachment: Nimbus-SOC2-TypeII-202611.pdf (pdf))

2) GDPR / HIPAA: GDPR applies (EU customers). HIPAA does not apply for the current scope — we do not process PHI for this integration.

3) VSQ: Attached is a filled-first-pass of your questionnaire (we answered everything we could; some infra details we flagged for follow up by your security team).
(Attachment: Nimbus-Completed-SQ.pdf (pdf))

4) Subprocessors: Short list below — happy to provide a spreadsheet if that helps.
   - Google Cloud Platform (us-west1) — compute & object storage
   - Segment (analytics pipeline) — telemetry routing (data minimization applied)
   - Sentry (error monitoring) — redacted traces only

We can provide a more formalized CSV. For the next steps, please send your subprocessor inventory and any specific questions your security folks flagged in the questionnaire.

Cheers,
Elena Soto
Head of Integrations | Nimbus Analytics
elena.soto@nimbus.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: third-party ecosystem checklist & SQ kickoff

Hi Elena / James —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the completed questionnaire. I reviewed the responses and attached our subprocessor inventory and a short data boundary note. Highlights below: 

- SOC 2: Thanks — the Nimbus SOC 2 (2026-11) looks in scope. We will add the audit to the deal file and flag no immediate blockers.
- Subprocessors we use for hosted Redwood: see attached spreadsheet (redwood-subprocessors-20270403.xlsx). Key entries:
   * AWS (us-west-2) — inference & KV cache (encrypted at rest)
   * GCP (us-central1) — embeddings index storage for certain customers (per-account config)
   * Datadog — telemetry/metrics (PII redaction enabled)
   * HashiCorp Vault — secrets management (customer keys in KMS)

Data boundaries / controls: 
- Customer data for this integration will be scoped to non-PII by default; keys/configurable flags exist for customers that require full index isolation.
- We do not share raw customer prompts with any analytics third party except when customers opt-in for usage analytics; Sentry traces are redacted.

Action items for Nimbus: 
- Please confirm whether Segment will receive any raw customer prompt text or just metadata.
- If you need a BAA for future PHI workloads, we can start the DPA/BAA process — contact legal-procurement@redwood.com and we'll route.

Attachments: redwood-subprocessors-20270403.xlsx (xlsx) and a mapping note. For the SOC 2 exchange, we can provide a secure download URL (one-time link) — see below.

Secure SOC 2 exchange: https://redwood.securefiles.company/soc2/SD-2027-typeII (one-time access, expires 2027-04-10)

I'll triage the flagged VSQ items in the next 48 hours and loop Grace for technical clarifications.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(Attachment: redwood-subprocessors-20270403.xlsx (xlsx))
